findings.message: The fix for malformed Context values ships single-case tests, not a variant table. Estimate and brief get one row, `Context: 70,000`. `record` gets no malformed-Context row. The budget line's `context=` gets one row, `70k`. The previous round named `70,000`, `70000 tokens` and `~70000`. Add a table-driven loop over `70,000`, `70000 tokens`, `~70000`, `7e4` and a trailing-text value. Run each through estimate, brief and record, and give the gate a `context=` row for each. Each row must assert a non-zero exit (or a loud toast for the gate) and that the task is named.
findings.scenario: Someone later changes `task_context` to `value.split()[0].isdigit()`. `Context: 70000 tokens` is then read as 70000 and `Context: ~70000` is still refused. The suite stays green, because it only tests `70,000` and `70k`. The class regresses in silence.

findings.message: The `--output` deny runs after quoted text is blanked, so a quoted spelling of the option is not seen. Quoting is the same spelling-variant class the previous finding named. The docs now call the gate a quality cap, so this is minor. Either test the unblanked part for `--output`, or document the quote bypass next to the existing `shortcut:` note.
findings.scenario: `git log '--output=f'` and `git diff "--output=f"` have the option blanked, so no `[<>]` or `--output` remains. The call passes in block mode, and git writes the file `f`.

findings.message: The missing-config check is applied only to `roles --json`. `brief` also calls `budget.load` and routes from `routing`. With no config.yaml it silently routes to the default agent and exits 0, which is the same 'defaults passed off as a read' defect. The roles test also covers only a nonexistent directory. It does not cover an existing directory with no config.yaml, or a directory named config.yaml. Give `brief` the same guard, or move the guard into one shared helper, and add those rows.
findings.scenario: `.specclaw/changes/001-x/tasks.md` exists but `.specclaw/config.yaml` is missing. `specclaw-budget brief .specclaw 001-x T1` prints the default `subagent_type` and exits 0, ignoring any routing the project would have configured.
